issues.detail: The evidence `contains` regex `tally/(cli|summary)\.py|-m tally (--help|-h)` requires the repository-relative path or the `-m tally` help form. A correct design that cites only `cli.py` or the console-script form `tally --help` would fail. Such a design is unlikely, because CONTEXT.md and the documentation mode both steer toward concrete repository paths.

issues.detail: The no-Build-Plan regex also fails a design that keeps a `## Build Plan` heading saying it is not applicable. The template and the documentation mode both say to omit the section, so this follows the skill. It is only marginally strict.
